basic_details.job_title: NPCC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 General Manager, Manager and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: General Manager (HR), Manager (Finance, HR, IT, Raj Bhasha), Dy. Manager (Fin., Law)
basic_details.short_information: NPCC Limited has 12 tentative regular vacancies across seven officer posts in HR, Finance, IT, Raj Bhasha and Law. Dy. Manager (Fin.) is the largest group with 4 vacancies. Online applications open on 1 November 2026 and close on 22 November 2026 at 11:59 P.M. All eligibility conditions, including age and experience, are counted as on 30 September 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the payment gateway only; no other mode is accepted.

age_limit.details: Post Upper Age Limit General Manager (HR) 50 years Manager (Finance, HR, IT, Raj Bhasha) 35 years Dy. Manager (Fin., Law) 30 years | The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer). Relaxation for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen is as per Govt. of India rules. For internal candidates, age is no bar.

qualification.details: The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer). Relaxation for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen is as per Govt. of India rules. For internal candidates, age is no bar. | Manager (Finance) and Dy. Manager (Fin.): knowledge of GST and Ind AS is desirable. Manager (Raj Bhasha): preference will be given to those having Ph. D. in Hindi. Dy. Manager (Law): an additional Post Graduate in Law is preferred. | Candidates in regular or contractual service on a pay scale in NPCC, other Government or Semi-Government organisations, PSUs, autonomous bodies or Govt. institutions need at least 2 years in the next below pay scale. Contractual staff on consolidated remuneration in these bodies, and candidates from the non-government or private sector, should have drawn the equivalent CTC for at least two years on the cut-off date. | Candidates claiming CTC must give Form 16 signed by an authorised officer, if applicable. The two-year requirement does not apply to candidates already in the same scale or above, though they must meet the other criteria. | The essential qualification, except CA and CMA, should be of minimum two-years duration for all posts except Dy. Manager (Law). For Dy. Manager (Law), Graduate in Law at Bar should be a 3 years course after Graduation or a 5 years course after Std. 12th. If the certificate does not mention a specialization, the candidate should furnish a certificate from the University/Institute specifying the specialization required. Where CGPA/OGPA or grading is awarded, the equivalent percentage should be shown in the application form as per the University/Institute's norms. NPCC decides the equivalence of qualifications, and its decision is final. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MBA/ Post Graduate Degree/ Post Graduate Diploma with specialization in HR/Personnel Management
MBA/Post Graduate Degree / Post Graduate Diploma with specialization in HR / Personnel Management
Master Degree in Hindi or its equivalent with English as a subject at the Degree Level

and NPCC's decision is final. The Offer of Appointment follows the final selection
which is based on performance in the interview or the other method used. Meeting the criteria and applying does not give a right to be called for interview.
how_to_apply: Read the full advertisement and make sure you meet all its conditions, as you must agree to them while applying.
Visit the NPCC website and click the online application link, or open the NPCC online application portal.
Fill in the application with a valid email ID. It cannot be changed once entered, and future correspondence may come by email, so keep it active for at least one year.
Upload legible copies of the documents listed below. Incomplete forms or insufficient documents may be rejected.
Pay the fee, if applicable, and submit before the closing time.
Matriculation/Secondary Certificate or Birth Certificate as proof of date of birth
Complete set of marksheets and degree certificate supporting the qualification and specialization
Proof of experience showing date of joining, date of relieving and pay scales/CTC for each position held
Pay-in-slip of the latest month, signed or certified by the department or organisation
Latest Form-16 of the last two financial years, if applicable
Category certificate in the Government of India format, if applicable
Disability certificate issued by the Competent Authority, if applicable
Income and Asset Certificate for EWS, valid for the financial year 2026-27, if applicable
Aadhar Card and any other supporting documents

All original certificates and documents must be produced at the interview, failing which a candidate may be disqualified from appearing. NPCC may ask for further documents by post or mail at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About NPCC
content_sections.text: National Projects Construction Corporation Limited is a Government of India enterprise and a Mini Ratna Category-I, Premier Schedule 'B' CPSU. It is a subsidiary of WAPCOS Limited and works in engineering, construction, planning, operation and project management consultancy. Its corporate office is at Plot No.148, Sector-44, Gurugram, and it has offices across India.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: General Manager (HR): Administration Department and Human Resource functions at the corporate office, including planning, organizing, staffing, development, coordination and periodical review of policies, systems and procedures. The post also handles Bi-partite/Tri-partite Settlements, adjudication, labour law cases and service matters. Manager (Finance): Institutional Finance, Budgetary Planning and Control, Central Treasury Management, Resources Generation, control of Accounts, Investment Planning, Auditing, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Taxation, Finance and Costing of Projects and MIS. The post also covers Income Tax and coordination with statutory/Govt. Auditors. Dy. Manager (Fin.): the same finance areas, from Institutional Finance through to Costing of Projects and MIS. Manager (HR): support, direction and advice to other division managers on HR procedure, policy, hiring, recruitment, training, compensation and promotion, plus IR matters, welfare, labour laws and related legal issues. Manager (IT): management and upkeep of information and communication systems, including software, hardware, networks and allied equipment. Manager (Raj Bhasha): compliance with the Official Languages Act and rules, including English-Hindi translation, preferably of technical and contractual documents. Dy. Manager (Law): managing all litigation filed by or against the company, managing related documents, drafting agreements and advising on compliance and regulatory issues.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the payment gateway only; no other mode is accepted.

rows.event: Cut-off date for all eligibility criteria

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: NPCC will decide the selection procedure depending on the response received. Selection can be by Personal Interview or by any other appropriate way, and NPCC's decision is final. The Offer of Appointment follows the final selection, which is based on performance in the interview or the other method used. Meeting the criteria and applying does not give a right to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can private-sector employees apply for NPCC posts?
faq.answer: Yes, if they have drawn the CTC listed for the post for at least two years, such as Rs. 8.97 Lakh per annum for Dy. Manager, and meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need to post a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No. Clause 23 of the general conditions says not to send any original documents, certificates or a hard copy of the application at this stage.

faq.question: Q3. Is the application fee refundable?
faq.answer: No. The fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, and it will not be held in reserve for a future selection.

faq.question: Q4. Are part-time or distance degrees accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualifications may be full-time, part-time, regular or distance, from an institution recognised by UGC/AICTE or an Indian or foreign institution granted equivalence or recognition by AIU.

faq.question: Q5. From when is experience counted?
faq.answer: Experience counts from the date of declaration of the result or the date of issue of the final mark sheet, provisional certificate or degree, whichever is earliest, up to the cut-off date.

faq.question: Q6. I work in a PSU. Do I need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: You should apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate at the interview. If that is difficult, you must produce a relieving order at joining, but you will not get service transfer benefits or pay protection.

faq.question: Q7. Does NPCC pay travel fare for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are paid to and fro rail fare from the nearest railway station of their declared residence, by the shortest route beyond 30 km, on producing the rail ticket. The entitlement is 2nd AC Sleeper for E-6 level and 3rd AC Sleeper for E-2 and E-1 levels.

faq.question: Q8. Where will corrections to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum, addendum or errata will appear only on www.npcc.gov.in, and no further press advertisement will be given.

faq.question: Q9. What can lead to rejection of a candidature?
faq.answer: Candidature can be rejected at any stage, even after recruitment, for false or fabricated information, suppressed facts or failure to meet the eligibility criteria. Canvassing, direct or indirect, also disqualifies a candidate.

faq.question: Q10. Which courts handle disputes about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Legal proceedings arising from the advertisement or applications are subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts at Delhi.
